title: Booking Trust Card for First-Time Salon Customers
simple_explanation: Many new customers worry about walking into a salon and getting surprised by the bill or a bad service. A simple booking message that shows the price, the time, and what they will get removes that fear before they even arrive.
do_this: Pick your top 3 services and write down the starting price for each one.
Add a short line about what is included in that price (like shampoo, conditioning, or styling).
Save this as one message you send on WhatsApp when someone asks 'How much?'
Always confirm the date and time in the same message.
Ask the customer to reply YES to confirm the booking.
example_for_business: A new customer messages the salon on WhatsApp asking for a haircut price. Instead of replying with just a number, the salon sends the full message above. The customer sees the price, what is included, and the shop hours. She replies with 'Haircut, Saturday 3 PM' and the slot is booked. No confusion, no surprises.
why_this_works: People book when they know the price and what they get before they come. A clear message saves time for both sides and builds trust fast.
how_to_know_it_worked: You will see more customers replying with a date and time. Fewer people will ask 'How much exactly?' or cancel on the day.

title: Hygiene Proof Card for Salon Customers
simple_explanation: Most salon customers silently worry about cleanliness. When they see that you care about hygiene, they feel safe and come back. A short post or reel showing your cleaning steps builds that trust without you having to say it out loud.
do_this: Take 3 short videos: one of you cleaning tools with sanitizer, one of fresh towels being taken out, one of the chair being wiped after a customer leaves.
Add a simple line on screen like 'Clean tools. Fresh towels. Every customer.'
Post it on Instagram Reels and also share it on your WhatsApp status.
Pin this post to the top of your Instagram profile for 2 weeks.
Save the same video to show new customers when they walk in.
copy_ready_text:
Clean tools. Fresh towels. Every single customer. 🧴✨

At {{businessName}}, we clean our scissors, combs, and chairs after every service. New towel for every wash. Sanitized tools every time.

Your safety is part of our service. 💛

📍 {{location}}
📞 Book on WhatsApp – link in bio
example_for_business: A salon in Kozhikode posts a 15-second reel showing the staff wiping the chair, opening a fresh towel packet, and dipping combs in sanitizer. The reel gets saved and shared by local college students. A new bride-to-be messages the salon saying she saw the reel and feels safe to book a facial.
why_this_works: People cannot see what happens between customers. When you show them, they stop guessing. Cleanliness shown is cleanliness believed.
how_to_know_it_worked: Customers will mention the hygiene in their Google reviews. You will also get DMs like 'Saw your reel, is it really that clean?' which means the post is doing its job.

title: WhatsApp Reply Templates for Common Salon Questions
simple_explanation: You get the same questions on WhatsApp every day: price, timing, location, and walk-in. Save ready-made replies so you can answer in 10 seconds and look professional even on busy days.
do_this: Open your WhatsApp Business app and go to Quick Replies.
Save 4 short replies: one for price, one for location, one for timing, one for walk-in.
Keep each reply under 4 lines so it is easy to read.
Add a friendly greeting in every reply.
Update the replies every time your price or timing changes.
copy_ready_text:
Quick Reply 1 – Price:
"Hi! Thanks for asking 😊 Here is our price list for {{serviceName}}: starts at {{startingPrice}}. Reply with the service you want and we will share the full details."

Quick Reply 2 – Location:
"We are at {{location}}, next to {{landmark}}. Easy to find on Google Maps. See you soon! 📍"

Quick Reply 3 – Timing:
"We are open from 10 AM to 8 PM, Tuesday to Sunday. Closed on Monday. What time works for you? 🕒"

Quick Reply 4 – Walk-in:
"Walk-ins are welcome but slots fill fast on weekends. Want me to book a time for you so you don’t have to wait? ✅"
example_for_business: On a busy Saturday, 3 customers message the salon at the same time asking different things. The owner uses Quick Replies and answers all 3 in under 2 minutes. One of them books a slot for a haircut, another asks for directions, and the third becomes a walk-in the same day.
why_this_works: Fast, clear answers make customers feel respected. They also stop calling you 5 times for the same thing. Saved replies save your time and look professional.
how_to_know_it_worked: You will reply to more customers in less time. Repeat customers will say things like 'I always get a quick reply from you' in their reviews.
